stages.title: What your body faces.
stages.text: Smoke, polluted air, toxins and everyday stress. Day after day, the body absorbs it — all the way down to the cell.

focusAreas.title: Breathe
focusAreas.subtitle: Lung health and quitting tobacco
focusAreas.descriptionShort: Support for your lungs, from daily lung booster gummies to a dual-action formula for smokers ready to quit.
focusAreas.description:
Every breath matters. City air, smoke and years of habit put your lungs under constant pressure.
Our Breathe range combines Ayurvedic herbs and modern nutrition to support respiratory health — and helps heavy smokers take control of cravings and breathe better.
focusAreas.whoText: Heavy smokers who are ready to quit, people cutting down step by step, and anyone exposed every day to traffic, dust and pollution.
focusAreas.whatText: PulmoClear Lung Booster Gummies support lung detoxification and respiratory health every day. Craving Control gummies add a calm-mind complex for smokers, with a simple 4-week plan towards smoke-free living.

focusAreas.title: Cleanse
focusAreas.subtitle: Liver health
focusAreas.descriptionShort: Eleven classical Ayurvedic herbs for daily liver care and digestive comfort.
focusAreas.description:
Your liver works around the clock, filtering what you eat, drink and breathe.
Our Cleanse range brings together eleven classical Ayurvedic herbs in a polyherbal concoction that supports liver detoxification, liver health and comfortable digestion.
focusAreas.whoText: People looking for daily detox and digestion support, busy professionals with irregular meals, and anyone who wants to give their liver steady, natural care.
focusAreas.whatText: LiverDetox is led by Bhumyamalaki, Kalmegh and Kutki. 10 ml twice a day after meals makes it an easy ritual to keep.

focusAreas.title: Balance
focusAreas.subtitle: Women's wellness and everyday vitality
focusAreas.descriptionShort: Plant-based roll-ons for menstrual comfort and everyday vitality.
focusAreas.description:
Balance is care designed around real lives.
Our Balance range uses dill and eucalyptus essential oils in simple morning roll-ons — CycleRelief for menstrual comfort, and Reviva as natural support for vitality for people managing diabetes.
focusAreas.whoText: Women who experience menstrual discomfort, and adults managing blood sugar who want a gentle, natural daily ritual alongside their doctor's advice.
focusAreas.whatText: Roll gently around the belly button every morning on an empty stomach. CycleRelief helps ease cramps and soothe abdominal discomfort; Reviva supports circulation, comfort and overall well-being.
